C1428.title: Sybil Attack Vulnerability Analysis in the Kad Network
C1428.summary: A paper presented at IEEE ICESS 2017 analyzed the Kad protocol and its source code and identified several design weaknesses exploitable by Sybil attacks. The researchers designed an attack that introduced many forged identities into the P2P file-sharing network to interfere with legitimate nodes, proposed a corresponding detection mechanism, and experimentally evaluated both the attack and the detector.

references.title: Research on the P2P Sybil Attack and the Detection Mechanism
